essence: Oblation performed with nirguṇḍī root effects release from the fetter.
The target's name and vital breaths are to be located in the specified place of the target.
One should recite at the root in the specified place and apply the target's name.
The target's form should be placed in that specified place.
One should dig beneath one's own seat and bury the face-up flour-made figure there.
